visualCharacteristics: A row of round-cornered, network-coloured share buttons on a light band; the WhatsApp button only shows on small screens.
contentPattern: One row per network: cell 1 the glyph as icon notation (:facebook:, :linkedin:, :mail:, :whatsapp:), cell 2 the share link whose text is the button accessible name.
usage: Use at the end of a page to let visitors share it via Facebook, LinkedIn, email or WhatsApp.
reuseGuidance: Reuse wherever share buttons are needed by adding or removing one row per network.
